decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service remains closely related to the firm's existing cloud, contact-centre and managed communications knowledge, so its high absorptive capacity and ability to refine the offer through internal R&D and partnerships make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

The call number routing platform sits even closer to the firm's core network and voice capabilities, and for a large expanding telecom provider this strong knowledge fit and operational learning argue for keeping and improving it rather than dropping it.
